name: Probe: raw engine expiry of the 8 start alliances on the JAC Japan map 15 km (historical), turns 27-34, with renewal variants V1-V5 per pair; relations script's KeepStartAlliances disabled via JAC_1534_KEEP_ALLIANCES_DISABLED; OUCHI human

steps.code: JAC_AEP={}; local P=JAC_AEP; P.pairs={{'R02','V1','HOJO','IMAGAWA'},{'R03','V5b','OUCHI','MORI'},{'R04','V2','DATE','ASHINA'},{'R05','V3','ASHIKAGA','ROKKAKU'},{'R06','V4','ASAKURA','ROKKAKU'},{'R07','V5a','ASHIKAGA','ASAKURA'},{'R08','V2b','AMAGO','MORI'},{'R19','V5c','SHIMAZU','RYUKYU'}}; function P.q(f) local ok,v=pcall(f); if ok then return tostring(v) end return 'ERR('..tostring(v)..')' end; function P.ids() local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName() or '','^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; return id end; P.names={}; for f,i in pairs(P.ids()) do P.names[i]=f end; function P.nm(i) return P.names[i] or tostring(i) end; function P.isPair(i,j) local x,y=P.names[i],P.names[j]; for _,r in ipairs(P.pairs) do if (r[3]==x and r[4]==y) or (r[3]==y and r[4]==x) then return true end end; return false end; function P.print(s) print('[JAC_ALLIANCE_EXPIRY_PROBE] '..s) end; function P.Log(label) local q=P.q; local id=P.ids(); local out={}; for _,r in ipairs(P.pairs) do local a,b=id[r[3]],id[r[4]]; local s; if a==nil or b==nil then s='missing player' else s=q(function() return P.row(a,b,r) end) end; local line='ctx='..P.ctx..' turn='..q(function() return Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() end)..' at='..label..' '..r[1]..' '..r[2]..' '..r[3]..'-'..r[4]..' '..s; P.print(line); table.insert(out,line) end; return table.concat(out,' | ') end; P.ctx='GameCore_Tuner'; function P.row(a,b,r) local q=P.q; local da,db=Players[a]:GetDiplomacy(),Players[b]:GetDiplomacy(); local x,y=r[3],r[4]; if x>y then x,y=y,x end; return 'hasAllied='..q(function() return da:HasAllied(b) end)..'/'..q(function() return db:HasAllied(a) end)..' atWar='..q(function() return da:IsAtWarWith(b) end)..' friend='..q(function() return da:HasDeclaredFriendship(b) end)..' friendTurn='..q(function() return da:GetDeclaredFriendshipTurn(b) end)..' turnsLeft='..q(function() return da:GetAllianceTurnsUntilExpiration(b) end)..' keepProp='..q(function() return Game:GetProperty('JAC_1534_ALLIANCE_'..x..'-'..y) end) end; function P.Set(from,to,val) local q=P.q; local id=P.ids(); local a,b=id[from],id[to]; if a==nil or b==nil then return from..'>'..to..' missing player' end; local r=q(function() Players[a]:GetDiplomacy():SetHasAllied(b,val); return true end); local v=q(function() Players[a]:GetDiplomacy():RecheckVisibilityOnAll(); Players[b]:GetDiplomacy():RecheckVisibilityOnAll(); return true end); return from..'>'..to..' SetHasAllied('..tostring(val)..')='..r..' recheck='..v..' hasAllied='..q(function() return Players[a]:GetDiplomacy():HasAllied(b) end) end; function P.Variant(tag,ops) local out={}; for _,o in ipairs(ops) do table.insert(out,P.Set(o[1],o[2],o[3])) end; local s='ctx=GameCore_Tuner turn='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()..' variant='..tag..' '..table.concat(out,'; '); P.print(s); return s end; function P.RemakeIfLapsed(from,to) local id=P.ids(); local a,b=id[from],id[to]; local s; if a==nil or b==nil then s='missing player' elseif Players[a]:GetDiplomacy():HasAllied(b) then s='still allied' else s='lapsed -> '..P.Set(from,to,true) end; s='ctx=GameCore_Tuner turn='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()..' variant=V4 R06 '..from..'-'..to..' '..s; P.print(s); return s end; local set=P.q(function() Game:SetProperty('JAC_1534_KEEP_ALLIANCES_DISABLED', true); return Game:GetProperty('JAC_1534_KEEP_ALLIANCES_DISABLED') end); local ev={}; for _,n in ipairs({'AllianceEnded','DiplomacyRelationshipChanged','DiplomacyDealExpired'}) do ev[#ev+1]=n..'='..P.q(function() Events[n].Add(function(...) local t={...}; if n~='DiplomacyRelationshipChanged' or P.isPair(t[1],t[2]) then local s={}; for i=1,select('#',...) do s[i]=tostring(t[i]) end; P.print('ctx=GameCore_Tuner event='..n..' turn='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()..' args='..table.concat(s,',')..' '..P.nm(t[1])..'-'..P.nm(t[2])) end end); return true end) end; local head='ctx=GameCore_Tuner setup keepDisabled='..set..' limit='..P.q(function() return GameInfo.GlobalParameters['DIPLOMACY_ALLIANCE_TIME_LIMIT'].Value end)..' renewActionInDb='..P.q(function() return GameInfo.DiplomaticActions['DIPLOACTION_RENEW_ALLIANCE']~=nil end)..' events '..table.concat(ev,' '); P.print(head); return head..' | '..P.Log('setup')
